newsitem.title: ITALY: Ambroveneto up on talk of Cariplo link.
newsitem.headline: Ambroveneto up on talk of Cariplo link.

text.p: Ambroveneto shares rose sharply on speculation that savings bank Cariplo may be considering a link-up with the Milan commercial bank, dealers said.
Ambroveneto was 5.88 percent higher at 4,340 lire in mid-afternoon after hitting a high 4,410 lire.
The bank's stock price was lifted after Deputy Chairman Alfonso Desiata declined to comment when reporters asked him whether Cariplo planned to subscribe to a planned capital increase by Ambroveneto.
Ambroveneto Chairman Giovanni Bazoli has said that the bank intends to make a substantial cash call before the end of the year. --Milan newsroom +392-66102321
